name: session_read
description: Read another session's context (read-only). Default digest mode shows a header (title, first prompt, message count, checkpoints) plus messages; raw mode renders messages only, including any reasoning_content as a 'reasoning:' line. Sessions are identified by their id from session_list. Pass `from` (canonical message index, 0-based) to page forward from an older message; without it the most recent `limit` messages are shown.

session_id.description: Session id (from session_list), 1-128 ASCII letters, digits, '-' or '_'.

mode.description: digest (default): header + recent messages; raw: messages only.

limit.description: Number of messages to show: the most recent ones when `from` is omitted, or the page size forward from `from` when it is given (default 20 for digest, 60 for raw; max 200).

from.description: Canonical message index (0-based, oldest first) to start reading from, paging forward by `limit`. Omit to show the most recent messages. Errors when out of range.
